operation.description: set: replace the data at path with value. update: change the children value names and keep the others; a key may be a path further down, such as profile/city, and null removes that child. delete: remove the data at path and everything under it.

path.description: Where to write, such as /users/alice. set and delete need a path below the root.

value.description: set: the new data, any JSON but null. update: an object of the children to change. A person approves the exact request.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
